notes.title: Sci-fi map update and many things changed
notes.notes:
1. Sci-fi map updated.

2. You can use the DLC contents in single play games.

3. Launch game in pvp game error was fixed.

4. Damage of a tower was lowered.

5. You can use personal lan method in find session menu. So, except for steam server operation time, you can host or find games.

5. Other minors updated.
